description: Team Peanut Butter is a student group from SMK St. Thomas investigating abandoned space equipment. Our project focuses on locating, researching, and documenting historic spacecraft left behind on the Moon and Mars, specifically the Viking 1 and 2 landers and the Apollo Lunar Modules.
summary:
This story is about a girl named Jasmine B. Blume 
exploring the Moon and Mars while trying to look for discarded equipment such as Apollo Lunar Modules,Lunar Roving Vehicle, Ingenuity Helicopters, Kepler Space Telescope, and Viking 1 & 2 Landers.
She studies the surfaces, landscapes, and histories of both worlds, carefully comparing each discovery
with what she knows about human exploration.Along the way, Jasmine records her observations,
follows clues left behind by earlier missions, and learns how every piece of equipment helped scientists
understand the Moon and Mars.
details:
Discover the Untold
Stories of Abandoned Equipment on the Moon and Mars: A Journey Through Human History in Space. We use CapCut, InShot, Canva, and IbisPaint. Instead of using AI technology for the artwork, we decided to do it manually using IbisPaint.
